note: Announced projects that may create work in or near Noida. These are announcements and projections, not vacancies, and are never counted as jobs. Job numbers are the figures given by the company or government at announcement. Trades listed are our inference.

items.title: Six Sense Mobility automotive electronics plant
items.distance: In Noida; likely a short commute from Sector 62/63
items.jobs_claimed: About 300 engineering and manufacturing roles, as the company plans to triple its workforce over two years
items.next_step: Find the plant address and contact HR for entry roles and whether they take ITI apprentices.

items.title: HCL-Foxconn semiconductor assembly and test unit (India Chip Pvt Ltd)
items.where: YEIDA, near Jewar airport, Gautam Buddh Nagar
items.distance: Same district, far from Sector 62/63 (long daily commute)
items.stage: Foundation stone laid 21 Feb 2026; expected to start in 2027
items.jobs_claimed: About 2,000 jobs (minister); a state document cites 3,780 direct and indirect
items.next_step: Ask about technician hiring timelines for 2027 and cleanroom training requirements.

items.title: Spark Minda auto component units
items.where: YEIDA Sector 10 and Sector 24, Gautam Buddh Nagar
items.next_step: Ask when production hiring starts and whether ITI pass-outs from Noida ITIs can be placed.
